patch_description: Terminal polish stages (dampers, reversal-damp escalation) have plateaued: prior generations varied only terminal damper strength with zero metric movement. The one untested structural lever is ordering. Replace the third micro-refinement pass (fixed Q/8, R from residual) with an adaptive-Q/8 pass that uses a locally adaptive block-MAD qseq estimated on the blended signal, and move the velocity clamp earlier — between pass 2 and pass 3 — so the refinement pass re-sharpens corners the clamp rounds while removed overshoot stays removed. The adaptive Q/8 estimates local second-difference energy per block, so quiet regions get more smoothing (fewer slope changes/false reversals) while dynamic regions get near-zero extra smoothing (lag preserved). The corridor monitor: if lag_error proxy (residual robust std of the final output's first differences relative to sigma_r) indicates over-smoothing, blend down w3. This targets the slope_changes (20.40) and false_reversals (14.20) metrics without touching lag_error (0.34) or accuracy (0.89).
